title: [BUG] Impossible to use a jpeg/jpg image to claude code
body:
## Environment
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.2 (Claude Code)
- Operating System: MacOS
- Terminal:  iTerm2 & Ghosty

## Bug Description
When sending a `jpg` or `jpeg` screenshot, claude code respond with an `error 400` from the anthropic API saying this is not png. 
This error persist even though I'm sending a `png` right away. I need to kill claude code and relaunch it.


## Expected Behavior
1. Ability to see jpg/jpeg and not only png 
2. The error should not persist when sending a .jpg then a .png


Thank you
author: tristanbes
